call.waitingDesc: Nobody might be free right now. Hang tight — the call connects automatically as soon as someone joins.
call.tip1: Sit somewhere quiet — headphones work best
call.tip2: Try using today's words in your sentences
call.tip3: Don't be afraid of mistakes — that's how you learn!
call.peerNetPoor: {name}'s network is weak — the call may stutter
call.selfNetSlow: Your network is slow — video may stutter
call.mediaDenied: Please allow camera/microphone access — it's required to make calls.
call.cameraDesc: Allow access in your browser, then try again. A video call needs both camera and mic.
call.shareHint: Code: {code} — share it with friends, they can join with this code
call.shareBanner: Share this code with friends — they can join the call with it
call.liveCorrectionHint: When you speak, AI catches mistakes here every ~30 seconds
call.liveCorrectionOff: Live correction is off — turn it on with the switch above
call.speechUnsupportedBody: This browser can't show live subtitles. Please use Chrome, or type in chat — your words still count.
call.chatEmpty: You can also text-chat during the call
call.roomClosedDesc: The room was closed or you were removed from it.
call.analyzeCta: Analyze the whole dialogue with AI
call.keyHint: Add your Gemini API Key in Settings to get the analysis.
call.immersiveHint: Full-screen call — press Esc to exit
